column3: NKJV has “into your hearts,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “into our hearts.”
NKJV has “an heir of God through Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “an heir through God.”
NKJV has “my trial,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “your trial.”
NKJV has “the mother of us all,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our mother.”
NKJV has “we … are children,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you … are children.”
